selection_rule.eligible: All 24 complete populations replay bitwise, no operational failure, both per-repetition speedups versus concurrency one at least 1.25.
selection_rule.ranking: Largest minimum speedup across the two repetitions; within five percent prefer fewer workers.
selection_rule.promotion: Development only; require separate fixed untouched-seed full-recipe timing/replay before production adoption.

limitations: Fixed existing development fits; no new pilot, phase-control fit, or posterior accuracy comparison.
Same four seeds repeated for counterbalanced timing; these repeats are not independent scientific replicas.
One GPU with eight allocated physical CPU cores throughout; not a 500-core capacity benchmark.
Original four-observation groups, density 4096, two worker threads and all sampler settings fixed.
Exactness covers saved outputs and all 64 stage records, not unrecorded mutation states or terminal RNG.
Source preparation timing excludes final declaration serialization and manifest/permission writes.
